notes: Support is now built into the app: start a ticket, read replies and reply back from Settings, and it is the same ticket you would see on the website. Sign-in now tells you what happened instead of waiting silently. Fixed: two copies could claim the same port on Windows and misroute a sign-in; the map opens where you last were; Check for updates shows whether it found anything. The macOS build is Apple Silicon only (M1 or newer).
